summary.text: Jade Eye Stone Monkey King is a hundred beast king ruling the jade eye stone monkeys of the rock forest under Qing Mao Mountain, killed by Fang Yuan for its Stealth Rock Gu.

claims.text: Hunting jade eye stone monkeys in the rock forest to feed his Jade Skin Gu, Fang Yuan finds a rock cave larger than the rest, arranged as if the surrounding caves revere it, and judges that a monkey king rules there. Ranking beast kings by the size of the group each commands, from hundred beast king through thousand beast king to myriad beast king, he reasons the jade eye stone monkey king is a hundred beast king ruling only several hundred stone monkeys, weaker than the wild boar king he fought earlier.

Three times the size of an ordinary stone monkey, the stone monkey king strikes Fang Yuan’s shoulder from concealment; his White Jade Gu blocks the attack. Fang Yuan judges that a wild concealing-type Gu worm hides it, leaving him unable to detect its position even as it drives over five hundred stone monkeys through the rock forest to chase him and keeps striking from hiding between chases. Unable to find its weakness and burning through his primeval essence, he judges his odds of winning without a stealth-removal Gu worm extremely low.

Fang Yuan lowers his own White Jade Gu as bait, then reactivates it the instant the stone monkey king strikes, and answers with a moonblade that tears a wound from its chest to its leg and drives it into hiding. Following the blood trail back to the rock forest’s center, he finds the stone monkey king already dead, its body gone rigid. A new stone monkey king has already taken its place, and the Gu worm that concealed the dead king drifts free toward the newcomer; Fang Yuan intercepts it, confirming his guess that the concealing worm is a rank one Stealth Rock Gu.
